Sergio’s Barber Shop

Mix it up with a haircut at Seattle's Sergio's Barber Shop. Walk-ins are welcome at this shop in Post Alley. The barbers at Sergio’s Barber Shop will get you in and out in a flash, so head on over during your lunch break.

The Market's own description, quoted as published.

The Market's page

No city business licence matched this name at a market address. Daystall craftspeople and farmers trade under the Market's own permits, which the city's licence file does not carry.
